contrast_name.Description: contrast name, from the design record or design.con

contrast_vector.Description: the contrast weights, one per design column

design.Description: how the contrast reads in the design

Levels.one-sample: a weight on a constant column
Levels.single-column: the sign of one column's coefficient

tested_direction.Description: what a positive statistic means, in the design's terms (randomise tests each contrast one-sided, t > 0)

contrast_tests.Description: what the contrast tests, in words, from the design record (empty when the design has no record)

df.Description: error degrees of freedom, n - rank(X)

n_vox_fwe.Description: voxels with FWE-corrected p below alpha

frac_mask_fwe.Description: n_vox_fwe as a fraction of the mask

min_p_fwe.Description: smallest FWE-corrected voxel p in the map

n_vox_uncorr.Description: voxels with uncorrected p below alpha (empty when randomise wrote no uncorrected maps)

frac_mask_uncorr.Description: n_vox_uncorr as a fraction of the mask

min_p_uncorr.Description: smallest uncorrected voxel p in the map

cluster_definition.Description: how clusters were formed for this test

significant_fwe.Description: any voxel with FWE-corrected p below alpha

whole_effect_n.Description: subjects with a finite whole-mask mean

whole_effect_df.Description: degrees of freedom of the whole-mask effect

whole_estimate.Description: the contrast estimate c'b on each subject's mean over the whole mask, in the measure's units

whole_d.Description: c'b / residual SD on each subject's mean over the whole mask: pooled-SD Cohen's d for two groups without covariates, mean / SD for one sample; never selected

whole_d_ci_low.Description: lower bound of whole_d (exact, noncentral t)

whole_d_ci_high.Description: upper bound of whole_d (exact, noncentral t)

whole_d_raw.Description: whole-mask d without covariate adjustment (pooled-SD for two groups, mean / SD for one sample)

whole_observed_direction.Description: the direction the whole-mask effect went
